# `legacy-sample.xls` provenance

- **Source**: `chinese-provinces.xls` from the Apache POI project's own
  `test-data/spreadsheet/` directory (the reference Java implementation for
  Office file formats — the JVM-world counterpart to SheetJS).
- **URL**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/poi/trunk/test-data/spreadsheet/chinese-provinces.xls`
- **Size**: 4096 bytes
- **SHA-256**: `0c4f1a10e9586ecda6b64a1f435ff8d8cd0a57d7e430e2f264a0d44e4c66d711`
- **Downloaded**: 2026-07-13
- **License**: Apache POI is an Apache Software Foundation top-level
  project, Apache-2.0 licensed by ASF-wide governance policy. Contributed
  test-data files are covered by the project's standard ASF contributor
  license agreement (the actual governing mechanism, not a per-file notice).
- **Content**: one sheet (`provinces`), 4 rows — a small table of Chinese
  province names in English and Chinese:
  ```json
  [["Provinces in China","Chinese Name"],["Anhui","安徽省"],["Beijing","北京市"],["Chongqing","重庆市"]]
  ```
- **Purpose**: independently-sourced (not generated by the pinned SheetJS
  build) legacy BIFF8 `.xls` fixture, proving the pinned `xlsx@0.20.3`
  artifact's read compatibility with real-world `.xls` producers — the
  compatibility claim the CDN-over-`exceljs` dependency decision was
  justified by (see [docs/dependency-accepted-risks.md](../../docs/dependency-accepted-risks.md)).
